data.title: Bitcoin Price Prediction: Macro Pressure Mounts as Yen Slides and Oil Climbs
data.description: Bitcoin traded at $78,500 as the Japanese yen breached 160 per dollar in Tokyo trading, while a U.S. strike on Iran’s Larak Island added to bearish price prediction. The moves followed Friday’s broad dollar advance and hawkish remarks from Warsh at Jackson Hole, which lifted expectations for a Federal Reserve ...
